finding: The M665 permit declares singleUse but has no persisted claim/consumption state or atomic outcome-unknown rule. Existing append-only journals provide history but do not bind a permit claim before adapter dispatch. A future executor must claim exactly once, persist the claim, and stop on uncertain persistence before dispatch or retry.
selectedNext: M667 code-only: define a pure single-use permit claim/consumption state machine and receipt contract with fail-closed idempotency and outcome-unknown states.
